records.title: Inspect models and actual motion

records.title: Author checks and motion captured
records.summary: Five logic cases cover 36 answer combinations. Browser checks exercise journeys, edits, search, keyboard focus, storage, reduced motion and fallback. Motion frames and a video are saved.

links.reason: Observed checks and visual review cover the recorded app state.

records.method: npm test; npm run build; browser-test.mjs; inspection of representative, mobile, pour, daylight and camera-transition screenshots.
records.context: Windows, Chromium 1234 with SwiftShader; 1440x1000 desktop and 390x844 mobile emulation. Exact source digest in verification-state.json.
records.limits: Camera-state samples and screenshots establish visible transitions, not user approval or physical-device smoothness. Video is retained for review; no population efficacy claim.
records.explanation:
